entities.summary: Gregory James Campbell is a Canadian former professional ice hockey centre and current Assistant General Manager of the Florida Panthers. He was drafted by the Panthers in the third round, 67th overall, in the 2002 NHL entry draft. Campbell is the son of former NHL player and current NHL Director of Hockey Operations Colin Campbell.
